subject.facility_name: VILLAGE GREEN REHABILITATION AND HEALTHCARE CENTER

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2024: direct care cost was $149.31 per resident day (38.4% of expenses); Connecticut median $169.07.
Cost year 2024: nursing home operating margin was -4.0% (Connecticut median 0.5%).

Cost year 2024: dietary cost $590,248, $26.6 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.6). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $590,248 (100.0%). Most food spending was a purchased (contracted) service ($435,701), so raw food per resident day is not comparable with homes that buy their own food.
Cost year 2024: housekeeping cost $189,074, $8.52 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.07). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $189,074 (100.0%).
Cost year 2024: laundry cost $193,516, $8.72 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.41). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $193,516 (100.0%).
Cost year 2024: the home reported $398,045 in management fees (cost report line m12), $17.94 per resident day (Connecticut median $10.84 among homes reporting a fee).

Missing data: cost years 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2024 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
